limitations: All eight challenge-enzyme/panel assays pass raw necessary100positive/100negative/1000total thresholds. This does not establish retention among1089 training heads.
Actual historical train/validation hash assignment, benchmark exclusions, InChI dedup choice and graph-building survival remain unknown.
Exact InChI and normalized-parent matches are not nested: InChI may equate tautomers that this parent normalizer does not; parent normalization removes salt/charge/stereochemistry.
Activity0 and1 are both supervised labels. Activation labels, panel labels and inhibitor/substrate labels are reported separately.
Panel1851 binary label cannot be assigned to a particular CYP;410 binary label lacks originalActivityDirection;1024title conflicts with its2C9 target/protocol.
No exact-InChI label conflicts were found in these eight assays;17 official compounds have0/1 differences among looser parent matches.
Blinded actualTEST outcomes are unknown; no same-target observed challenge-label intersection can be computed for actualTEST.
